Overall, the technical analysis gives a neutral to slightly bearish indication on the stock. It is important to watch the price action closely in the next few trading days to see if this divergence continues and the stock starts to trend higher. However, it is also important to note that the observed period is small and the indicators could change significantly going forward.

The overall risk is medium as well, due to the price being in the middle of its range and the lack of a clear trend.
